llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must set `lazy` to `true` on tab screens so non-visited tabs are rendered only on first visit.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Home screen has lazy: false explicitly set, violating the requirement that lazy must be true on tab screens so non-visited tabs are rendered only on first visit.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define `initialRouteName` on the bottom tab navigator to make the initially rendered tab explicit.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: initialRouteName is explicitly set to 'Home' on the bottom tab navigator.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must implement tabs with `createBottomTabNavigator` (not stack/drawer/top-tabs) for this flow.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: createBottomTabNavigator is imported from @react-navigation/bottom-tabs and used to create the TabNavigator.
